brands.name: Grace Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-built surfboards by Phil Grace on the Mornington Peninsula — classic longboards and performance shapes refined in Australian and Basque point waves.

models.name: Silver Fox
models.description: An evolution of the legendary Silver Fox template — vintage soul with modern performance, built for effortless glide and smooth single-fin arcs with Gracey's signature rolled V and rail work.

models.name: Single Fin
models.description: A throwback single-fin with the wide point pushed forward, subtle double concave for speed, and Gracey's signature fin — old soul with modern spark for style-first surfing.

models.name: The Glider
models.description: Phil Grace's ode to graceful lines and long journeys — a paddle machine for effortless trim from small surf to head-high, with rolled V bottom and soft downturned rails.

models.name: Demibu
models.description: The original all-rounder by Phil Grace — smooth transitions, fast rail-to-rail response, and total control from playful beach breaks to punchier surf, available as thruster or twin.

models.name: All Rounder
models.description: A versatile longboard with 3x single plus side-bite fin boxes — balanced glide and control for everyday logging across a wide range of conditions.

models.name: Nose Rider
models.description: Refined on Torquay and Basque Country point waves — a classic noserider with generous nose, deep spoon concave, and rail-setting performance for graceful walks to the tip.

models.name: The Heritage
models.description: A tribute to longboarding's golden era with retro hip, rolled V bottom, and soft downturned rails — built for soulful trimming, graceful footwork, and laid-back single-fin style.
